calc:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads an h by w grid where '#' marks a mine, replaces every non-mine cell with the number of mines in its eight neighboring cells, and prints the resulting mine-count grid." calc]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> h </REF>: int "Number of rows in the grid."
        <REF> w </REF>: int "Number of columns in the grid."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: int "Always returns 0 after processing and printing the grid."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare a 2D integer array panel of dimensions h by w and a character array row of length w. RESULT panel, row]
            [COMMAND For each row index i from 0 to h-1, read a string from standard input into row using scanf("%s", row). RESULT row]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over rows, for each column index j from 0 to w-1, set panel[i][j] to -1 if row[j] is '#', otherwise set it to 0. RESULT panel]
            [COMMAND For each row index i from 0 to h-1, iterate over each column index j from 0 to w-1. RESULT i, j]
            [COMMAND Within the nested loop, if panel[i][j] is -1, continue to the next j iteration. RESULT current_cell]
            [COMMAND For a non-mine cell at (i, j), initialize count to 0. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND Check the eight neighboring positions (i-1,j-1), (i-1,j), (i-1,j+1), (i,j-1), (i,j+1), (i+1,j-1), (i+1,j), and (i+1,j+1); for each position that is within the bounds 0 <= row < h and 0 <= col < w and whose panel value is -1, increment count. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND Assign panel[i][j] = count, replacing the empty cell value with the neighboring mine count. RESULT panel]
            [COMMAND For each row index i from 0 to h-1, iterate over each column index j from 0 to w-1. RESULT i, j]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, print '#' if panel[i][j] is -1; otherwise print the integer value panel[i][j] using printf("%d", panel[i][j]). RESULT printed_output]
            [COMMAND After completing an output row, print a newline character. RESULT printed_output]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from the function. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
